translationRepairs: Several hundred people in the capital were killed by the earthquake, and inside the Gate of Virtuous Clarity the head of a stone dragon was shaken loose; the learned took stone to be the dynastic surname of the house—a dire omen indeed.

Several hundred people in the capital were killed by lightning, and inside the Gate of Virtuous Clarity the head of a stone dragon was shaken loose; the learned took stone to be the dynastic surname of the house—a dire omen indeed.
The immediately preceding 大雷雨 controls the sense of 震死: hundreds were killed by lightning, not by a separate earthquake.

At that time several hundred people in the capital were killed by the quake; inside the Gate of Virtuous Clarity the head of a stone dragon fell from the shock, and those who understood such things held that stone was the dynastic surname—surely a most inauspicious sign.

At that time several hundred people in the capital were killed by the lightning strike; inside the Gate of Virtuous Clarity the head of a stone dragon fell from the shock, and those who understood such things held that stone was the dynastic surname—surely a most inauspicious sign.
In the thunderstorm context, 震死 means killed by lightning; the paired literal field must carry the same meaning.

On jiayin, Jia Wei, Imperial Diarist and edict drafter, became Director of the Bureau of Household Registers while retaining his drafting post.
起居郎 was a court diarist who recorded imperial activity, not a recorder attached to the heir apparent.
On jiayin, Jia Wei, Recorder of the Heir Apparent and drafter of edicts, was made Director of the Bureau of Household Registers and continued as drafter of edicts.
On jiayin, Jia Wei, Imperial Diarist and drafter of edicts, was made Director of the Bureau of Household Registers and continued as drafter of edicts.
The literal field contains the same office mistranslation and should render 起居郎 as Imperial Diarist.
